title: PaymentSettled
description: Sent by the payment system on topic payments.settled when a payment settles. Keyed by paymentId. The ledger records one transaction per paymentId, however many times and under however many eventIds the message arrives.

eventId.description: Unique per delivery attempt; a re-send may carry a new one

paymentId.description: Identity of the payment; the deduplication key

merchantAccountId.description: Ledger account credited with the settlement

amount.description: Positive decimal string in major units
